title: Input facts for stig.rhel_10: DISA STIG, RHEL 10
description: Facts the DISA STIG module for RHEL 10 reads, from its reviewed rule table (100 rules). `required` lists the evidence of rules that always apply: absent or null, the rule is Open with 'evidence missing'. Evidence of a rule with a Not Applicable clause is in x-required-when-applicable. Collect the observed value, not a verdict. Human-readable form: benchmarks/stig/LINUX_COLLECTOR_CONTRACT.md.
